test_readonly_dict: test that make_read_only converts a dict to a ReadOnlyDict that rejects all mutations
test_readonly_list: test that make_read_only converts a list to a ReadOnlyList that rejects all mutations
test_nested_readonly_containers: test that make_read_only recursively wraps nested dicts and lists while preserving tuple types
test_copy_on_readonly_dict: test that shallow copy of a ReadOnlyDict preserves key-value pairs but keeps nested dicts read-only
test_deepcopy_on_readonly_dict: test that deepcopy of a ReadOnlyDict produces a fully mutable independent copy
